The system is highly confident (96%) in this diagnosis based on the characteristic appearance of the spots. Brown Spot is a fungal disease caused by Cochliobolus miyabeanus and is often associated with nutrient deficiencies, particularly potassium. The uniform size and distribution of spots are distinct from other foliar diseases.

This condition can cause significant yield losses as it affects grain filling and can lead to panicle breakage.
